info.name: Media Management API
info.description: Run with the generated environment (npm run test:postman). Success flow asserts 200 OK; the Security folder deliberately asserts the correct 4xx codes.

exec: pm.test('db + storage ok', () => pm.expect(j.data.checks).to.eql({ database: 'ok', storage: 'ok' }));
pm.test('Folder id is a decimal string', () => pm.expect(j.data.id).to.match(/^[0-9]+$/));

pm.test('assetId is auto-assigned BIGINT string beyond JS safe integer', () => { pm.expect(d.assetId).to.match(/^[0-9]{16,19}$/); pm.expect(BigInt(d.assetId) > BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: PUT binary to signed upload URL

exec: pm.test('Dimensions extracted by worker', () => { pm.expect(j.data.width).to.eql(640); pm.expect(j.data.height).to.eql(400); });
else { pm.collectionVariables.set('pollVariants', 0); pm.test('Condition reached', () => pm.expect(j.data.variants.length >= 4 && j.data.variants.every(v => v.status === 'READY')).to.eql(true)); }

item.name: Read-only token cannot create upload session -> 403
Spoofed X-Tenant-Id header is ignored (other tenant list is empty)

exec: pm.test('No leak of tenant 1001 assets', () => pm.expect(j.data.map(a => a.id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('assetId')));
